serialization: game/missions.mjs saveProgress/loadProgress; stable step IDs and validated narrative/world records.
defaults: newProgress() and newWorld(); initial coins 30; default narrative thermal 50.
flags: Bounded by validateNarrativeState; narrative v8 source of truth in story-v08.mjs.
migration: Existing valid schema-7 raw JSON is accepted and gains integrity metadata on its next successful write. Earlier campaign versions are preserved, not silently migrated into canon 8; new story required as already specified in v8.

integrity.coverage: JSON.stringify of the serialized checkpoint excluding integrity
integrity.purpose: Accidental corruption detection; not cryptographic authentication.

atomicity: localStorage.setItem is the atomic unit. Save a validated previous primary into backup, then replace primary. On first save seed backup; on explicit new game seed it with the new initial checkpoint.
corruption: Validate checksum and campaign schema; if primary fails, offer validated backup. If both fail, retain data and show usable menu without Continue. Never reinterpret corrupt bytes as a legacy campaign.
recovery_loss_bound: One prior persist checkpoint; no zero-loss guarantee for unsaved in-memory progress.
quota_or_denial: Return failure, retain prior data and display explicit save-unavailable notice; no success indicator.
backup_platform: Local app-origin backup only. Android allowBackup remains false; no cloud backup, reinstall recovery or cross-device recovery claimed.
